items.t: Start with a low dose: one tablet daily, increased gradually until effective diuresis; maximum two tablets a day. Aim for gradual weight loss; reduce the dose when weight is stable.

items.t: Hyperkalaemia (deaths reported), especially in the elderly, diabetes, renal impairment, cirrhosis or heart failure: observe for clinical, laboratory and ECG signs; stop immediately if hyperkalaemia develops.

items.t: Renal impairment: monitor electrolytes and urea carefully (rapid hyperkalaemia, cumulative effects); stop if uraemia and oliguria increase. Thiazides become ineffective when CrCl falls below 30 ml/min.

rules.consequence: Rapid hyperkalaemia and cumulative effects may develop; uraemia may be precipitated or increased.
rules.action: Use with caution; monitor serum electrolytes and blood urea carefully; stop if uraemia and oliguria increase.

src.q: Co-amilozide should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment.
Renal function should be monitored carefully for serum electrolytes and blood urea levels
If increasing uraemia and oliguria develop during treatment, Co-amilozide should be discontinued.

rules.concern: Severely ill patients in whom metabolic or respiratory acidosis may occur
rules.consequence: Acidosis may be associated with rapid increases in plasma potassium.
rules.action: Start potassium-conserving therapy only with caution.

rules.concern: Medicines that prolong the QT interval
